audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is templated "Skill" on all 7 rows, contradicting content win[] (Poppy Levels 1-2, Braum Level 3 through 6, Poppy First item and Two+ items).
audit.why: Braum's only ranged tool early is a slow Winter's Bite, so Poppy's E-stun wins the level-1/2 all-in before he stacks Concussive Blows; from level 3 Unbreakable blocks Poppy's Q and his passive stun punishes melee commitment, until Poppy's R and item power let her out-disrupt his one-directional shield again.
audit.corrected: Side set to Poppy for Levels 1-2, Braum for Level 3, Levels 4-5, Level 6, Poppy for First item and Two+ items — matching the existing content win[] chart exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Unbreakable's cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s) and its one-directional block are the concrete facts that decide when to poke and from which angle.
audit.corrected: Added Unbreakable's per-rank cooldown and its one-sided blocking, plus Glacial Fissure's cooldown and its grounding effect on Poppy's own dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: No missing-interactions entries were flagged for this matchup, and the existing content prose (win[]/whys[]/spikes[]) already correctly identifies Unbreakable blocking Poppy's Q/E and Concussive Blows' 4-stack stun.
audit.why: Both kits were cross-checked (Braum's Unbreakable blocks projectiles including Poppy's E dash-hit trajectory-adjacent poke; his R Glacial Fissure grounds dashes, which would stop Poppy's own W/E if she tried to dash through it) and nothing further applies beyond what content already states.
audit.corrected: No change needed to point 4 beyond the full-layer chart fix above.
